programme.title: Mia i ja: Film, film
programme.desc: Mia je opet pozvana u sjajni svijet jednoroga, Centopiju, gdje upoznaje s Ikom, vilenjaka s otoka Lotusa koji očajnički treba njezinu pomoć. Toxor, monstruozni zlikovac nalik žabi, preuzima vlast nad otokom pretvarajući stanovnike u vojsku bezvoljnih pristalica svojom mračnom čarolijom. Mia i njezini stari i novi prijatelji slijede stope mitske junakinje iz Centopije kako bi ujedinili tri drevna, čarobna kamena moći da poraze Toxora. Na svom pustolovnom putovanju sprijateljit će se s veoma posebnim jednorogom dok će se boriti s Toxorovom dosadnom i odanom vojskom. Dok velika bitka za otok Lotus postaje misija spašavanja, Mia će naučiti što znači biti junakom i naposljetku će morati donijeti odluku koja će joj zauvijek promijeniti život.

programme.title: U sebi, film
programme.desc: Kada nevidljivi neprijatelj zaprijeti čovječanstvu zauzimanjem ljudskih tijela i brisanjem sjećanja, Melanie Stryder (Saoirse Ronan) riskirat će sve da zaštiti ljude d kojih joj je najviše stalo - Jareda (Max Irons), Iana (Jake Abel), svog brata Jamieja (Chandler Canterbury) i svog strica Jeba (William Hurt), dokazujući da ljubav može pobijediti sve u opasnom novom svijetu...

programme.title: Lassie, film
programme.desc: Lassie spasi lisicu od pasa tragača koji pripadaju vojvodi od Rudlinga (Peter O’Toole) pa plemić poželi pametnog ovčara kupiti svojoj maloj unuci Cilli (Hester Odgers). No ovčar već ima prijatelje koji ga obožavaju - rudara Sama Carraclougha (John Lynch) i njegovu obitelj, suprugu Saru (Samantha Morton) i sina Joea (Jonathan Mason). No Sam je otpušten s posla i primoran je prodati vjernog psa kako bi obitelji pružio neki novčani oslonac. Iako je sada Lassie dio plemićke obitelji, nije zaboravio svoje stare prijatelje te im se u nekoliko navrata pokušava vratiti. Iživciran Lassiejevim ponašanjem, Rudling zapošljava Eddieja Hynesa (Steve Pemberton) da psa nauči poslušnosti.

programme.title: Džingis Kan - ratnik i vladar, film
programme.desc: Epski film prema povijesnim događajima o mladosti Temudžina koji je poslije postao poznat kao Džingis-kan. Dvadeset godina prije početka priče, 1172. godine, devetogodišnji Temudžin kreće na ekspediciju sa svojim ocem Yesügeijem kako bi izabrao djevojku koja će mu biti buduća žena. Na putu kući Yesügeija otruje neprijateljsko pleme, na izdisaju kaže svome sinu da je on sada kan. No Targutai, Yesügeijev poručnik, sebe proglasi kanom i sprema se ubiti mladog suparnika... Film je 2008. nominiran za Oscara za najbolji film na stranom jeziku.

programme.title: Kin, film
programme.desc: Napeti SF triler producenata megapopularne serije Stranger Things. Priča prati bivšeg zatvorenika koji je u bijegu od federalnih vlasti, izvanzemaljskih vojnika i bande na čijem je čelu James Franco. Jedina pomoć mu je mlađi polubrat koji se slučajno dokopao izvanzemaljskog oružja. Braći ubrzo postaje jasno da se moraju dati u bijeg, a kao jedina zaštita dvojcu služi pronađeno misteriozno moćno oružje koje im je zadnja šansa za preživljavanje. Glumačku postavu, uz Jamesa Franca, čine Carrie Moon, Zoë Kravitz, Dennis Quaid i mladi Myles Truitt.

programme.title: Drakula: Buđenje zla, film
programme.desc: Zastrašujuća priča o trgovačkom brodu Demeter, koji je unajmljen za prijevoz privatnog tereta - pedeset neoznačenih drvenih sanduka koji plove do Londona. Na tom putovanju čudni događaji zadese posadu koja pokušava preživjeti oceansko putovanje, svake noći praćeni nemilosrdnom prisutnošću na brodu. Kada Demeter konačno stigne do obala Engleske, to je pougljenjena, napuštena olupina, a od posade nema ni traga.

programme.title: Grimizne rijeke, film
programme.desc: Dva će odvažna čovjeka morati prevladati nesuglasice i udružiti snage u istrazi koja će pokazati kako strašni nacistički zločini ni desetljećima nakon završetka rata ne prestaju mučiti nevine žrtve. Pierre Niemans (Jean Reno) i Max Kerkerian (Vincent Cassel) dva su policajca koja rade na odvojenim slučajevima. Mjesta zločina udaljena su 300 kilometara. Niemans istražuje ubojstvo na udaljenom planinskom sveučilištu u mjestu Guernon, a Kerkerian oskvrnuće groba djevojčice koje su počinili skinheadsi. Kad im se tragovi, svjedoci i područja istraga počnu preklapati, oni se isprva sukobljavaju, ali povećan broj ubojstava natjerat će ih da počnu surađivati jer će samo tako moći stati na kraj tajanstvenim zločincima.

programme.title: Strava iz dubina, film
programme.desc: Bračni je par za svoje romantično putovanje odabrao udaljenu vilu okružnu morem u čarobnom Vijetnamu. Spušta se jaka oluja, vila se pretvara u splav, a struja mladi par izbacuje u more. Odjednom se pojavljuje još jedna opasnost: jato velikih bijelih morskih pasa. Dok njezin ozlijeđeni suprug bespomoćno promatra zvijeri iz dubina, Jaelyn (Alicia Silverstone) se sama mora boriti sa smrtonosnim grabežljivcima.

programme.title: Apači, film
programme.desc: Montmartre, 1900. g. Nasilna banda pod nadimkom «Apači» terorizira grad. Odlučna osvetiti ubojstvo svoga brata, mlada žena po imenu Billie ubaci se u zločinački klan koji ga je ubio. Njezin plan: ubiti svakoga od njih, jednog po jednog, dok se previše ne približi njihovom zadivljujućem vođi...

programme.title: Džingis Kan - ratnik i vladar, film
programme.desc: Epski film prema povijesnim događajima o mladosti Temudžina koji je poslije postao poznat kao Džingis-kan. Dvadeset godina prije početka priče, 1172. godine, devetogodišnji Temudžin kreće na ekspediciju sa svojim ocem Yesügeijem kako bi izabrao djevojku koja će mu biti buduća žena. Na putu kući Yesügeija otruje neprijateljsko pleme, na izdisaju kaže svome sinu da je on sada kan. No Targutai, Yesügeijev poručnik, sebe proglasi kanom i sprema se ubiti mladog suparnika... Film je 2008. nominiran za Oscara za najbolji film na stranom jeziku.

programme.title: Prste(n) k sebi, film
programme.desc: Skroman mehaničar u zabavnom parku, Sam, sanja o svojoj ljubavi iz djetinjstva, Sue. Vjeruje kako samo blještavim prstenom može osvojiti djevojku svojih snova te organizira savršenu večer kako bi zaprosio ljubav svog života. Ali kad se pojavi superzlikovac Oscar sa svojim zlim planom i prstenom, Samovi planovi su uništeni. Zabunom zamijene prstene. Sam i njegova ekipa superjunaka robota kreću u potragu za prstenom i pokušavaju spasiti grad… Na tom putovanju nauče da nije važno blještavilo, već ono što je u srcu.

programme.title: Kin, film
programme.desc: Napeti SF triler producenata megapopularne serije Stranger Things. Priča prati bivšeg zatvorenika koji je u bijegu od federalnih vlasti, izvanzemaljskih vojnika i bande na čijem je čelu James Franco. Jedina pomoć mu je mlađi polubrat koji se slučajno dokopao izvanzemaljskog oružja. Braći ubrzo postaje jasno da se moraju dati u bijeg, a kao jedina zaštita dvojcu služi pronađeno misteriozno moćno oružje koje im je zadnja šansa za preživljavanje. Glumačku postavu, uz Jamesa Franca, čine Carrie Moon, Zoë Kravitz, Dennis Quaid i mladi Myles Truitt.

programme.title: Clara, film
programme.desc: Isaac Bruno (Patrick J. Adams) astronom je potpuno opsjednut potragom za životom u svemiru. Kada mu ta opsesija ugrozi karijeru, ignorira prijateljev savjet da vrati svoj život u normalu te se još dublje posveti istraživanju - djelomično kako bi pobjegao od tragedije iz prošlosti. Nakon što Isaac upozna umjetnicu Claru (Troian Bellisario), koja je podjednako fascinirana svemirom i vrlo dobro otkriva uzorke, ovo dvoje ljudi neočekivano počne surađivati: pretražuju gomilu novih podataka o svemiru, nadajući se da će otkriti nešto kolosalno.

programme.title: Replike, film
programme.desc: Povratak Keanua Reevesa u filmove znanstvene fantastike. Film propitkuje etičnost povratka mrtvih u život, bavi se problemom suočavanja s modernom tehnologijom i kloniranjem obitelji u podrumu. Poznati neuroznanstvenik William Foster, čiji su supruga i troje djece poginuli u prometnoj nesreći, potpuno očajan uz pomoć svog najboljeg prijatelja i kolege znanstvenika Eda Whittlea, odlučuje se na rizičan eksperiment - repliciranje njihovih tijela. Ništa ga neće zaustaviti u tome, čak i ako mora ići protiv cijelog vladinog laboratorija, policije, ali i zakona fizike.

programme.title: Bogovi Egipta, film
programme.desc: Opstanak čovječanstva je u rukama običnog smrtnika, heroja Beka, kojeg glumi Brenton Thwaites. Bek se udružio sa egipatskim bogom Horusom (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) kako bi spasio svijet koji je u rukama Seta (Gerard Butler), nemilosrdnog boga tame. Otkako je Set preuzeo vlast, nekada mirno i prosperitetno egipatsko carstvo postalo je poprište kaosa i sukoba. Bek i Horus kreću u konačan obračun sa Setom i njegovim pristalicama.

programme.desc: Nakon što grupa studenata medicine otkrije kako oživjeti preminule, svoje će znanje upotrijebiti na nesretno stradaloj kolegici. No, prvotnu sreću zbog njezinog povratka među žive, ubrzo zamjenjuje užas, jer njihova Zoe nije više ista.

programme.title: Underworld, film
programme.desc: Mladi liječnik Michael Corvin (S. Speedman) svjedoči krvavom obračunu dviju bandi. I ne sluti da to nisu obične ulične bande, nego bića koja žive skrivena od ljudi: vampiri i vukodlaci. Selene (K. Beckinsale), jedna od od najuglednijih članica vampirskog plemena, koje se zove Death Dealers, otkriva da vukodlaci proganjaju Michaela, ali ne razumije zašto, budući da je on običan smrtnik. Ne zna da Michael nosi u sebi nešto što bi vampirima, zvanima Lykans, omogućilo da stvore hibridnu vrstu vukodlaka, ojačaju i pobijede vampire jednom zauvijek. Slijedeći Michaela da ga zaštiti, Selene se u njega zaljubi, iako nije vrijeme za ljubav, jer Lykansi pripremaju i konačni obračun s Death Dealersima...

programme.title: Underworld 2, film
programme.desc: Rat između vampira i vukodlaka nastavlja se i zaoštrava. Otkriva se zamršena prošlost i razlozi zbog kojih zaraćeni klanovi stoljećima vode nemilosrdnu borbu, koja postaje sve brutalnija. Vampirica Selene (Kate Beckinsale) ubila je svog nekadašnjeg zaštitnika Victora (Bill nighy), jednog od vampirskih vladara. Nada se oprostu nakon što prvom vladaru Marcusu (Tony Curran) objasni svoje razloge. Michael (Scott Speedman) nekad običan čovjek, a sada hibrid vampira i vukodlaka želi ići s njom, no ona to odbija zato što ne vjeruje vukodlaku u njemu. Međutim Marcus je i sam postao hibrid, a kada se probudi iz sna htjet će ubiti Selene i Michaela. Okršaji i borbe pokazat će da je ljubav između Selen i Michaela jača od svega. Selena saznaje da ni Marcus ni njezin bivši zaštitnik Viktor nisu bili prvi Besmrtnici. Prvi je bio Alexander Corvinus (Steven Mackintosh) Marcusov otac. Saznaje da i Marcus ima brata blizanca Williama, s kojim želi zavladati svijetom

programme.title: Super, film
programme.desc: Život kuhara Franka (Rainn Wilson) raspada se kad ga njegova lijepa supruga Sarah (Liv Tyler) ostavi zbog Jacquesa (Kevin Bacon), karizmatičnog vlasnika striptiz-kluba i dilera, koji ju je ponovo navukao na drogu. Frank tada odluči postati superheroj, te uzima ime "Grimizna munja" - a njegova je supermoć u spretnom korištenju francuskog ključa, s kojim premlati najrazličitije negativce. Uskoro dobiva i pomoćnicu - Libby (Ellen Page), slatkicu iz trgovine stripovima, koja se kao "Munjica" pokaže jednako sposobna u suočavanju sa zločincima. Par "superjunaka" kreće u superobračun sa Jacquesom…

programme.title: Tvornica snova, film
programme.desc: Minnin se život preokrenuo naglavačke kada joj se u dom doselile tatina zaručnica Helena i njezina kći Jenny. Njezina je nova polusestra nepodnošljiva i Minna je radi toga jako nezadovoljna. Želi da je nema! Jedne noći, ona otkriva svijet iz mašte u kojem neobični graditelji stvaraju naše snove i otkriva kako njima manipulirati. Ali miješanje u snove ljudi ima strašne posljedice i kad Minna jedne noći ode predaleko, Jenny se više ne može probuditi. Minna mora posljednji put ući u svijet snova kako bi se suočila s onima koje je sama stvorila i kako bi spasila Jenny i svoju novu obitelj.

programme.title: Različita, film
programme.desc: Film je nastao na temelju bestselera Veronice Roth i smješten je u svijet u kojem su ljudi podijeljeni u pet skupina, s obzirom na prevladavajuće osobine svojih ličnosti. Tris (Shailene Woodley) je rođena u skupini koja se bori protiv taštine, napadne odjeće, bilo čega čime bi se pojedinac isticao. Svakome od pripadnika te skupine važan je drugi čovjek. No Tris osjeća da ne pripada toj grupi jer ne razmišlja uvijek o drugima. Svaki građanin sa 16 g. mora proći testiranje kojim se određuje kojoj bi grupi najbolje pripadao, no za Tris se iz njenog testiranja nije mogao izvući konačni zaključak pa je sama morala donijeti odluku. To je opasna odluka jer se Tris ne uklapa ni u jednu grupu, ona je različita i to mora sakriti. Kada otkrije urotu kojoj je cilj uništiti sve različite, a koju predvodi Jeanine Matthews (Kate Winslet), Tris će morati uz pomoć Foura (Theo James) otkriti što ih čini toliko različitima da su opasni.

programme.title: Trilogija Različita: Pobunjena, film
programme.desc: Nakon što je otkrila da ne pripada niti jednoj frakciji, Beatrice Prior mora izabrati svoj daljnji život. Rastrgana između društvenih pravila i vlastitog puta kojeg smatra jedino ispravnim ona će pokazati da biti različita nije više mana, nego najveća prednost.

programme.title: Trilogija Različita: Odana, film
programme.desc: Što ako je cijeli tvoj svijet bio laž? Što ako samo jedno otkriće, baš kao i samo jedna odluka, može promijeniti sve? Što ako ćeš zbog ljubavi i odanosti napraviti neočekivane stvari? Nakon što je društvo u koje je vjerovala uništeno nasiljem i željom za moći, Tris se zajedno s Tobiasom odlučuje otići i istražiti granice svijeta koji ne poznaje. No, nova otkrića i istine koje izlaze na vidjelo ponovno će zahtijevati od Tris da se suoči s nepredvidljivošću ljudske prirode, ali i sa samom sobom. Istovremeno, i Tris i Tobias moraju se suočiti s činjenicom da se njihov položaj u društvu promijenio, te oni koji su bili privilegirani to više nisu.

programme.title: Nikad ne puštaj, film
programme.desc: Dok Zlo preuzima svijet izvan njihovog praga, jedina zaštita za majku, koju glumi dobitnica Oscara® Halle Berry (glavna glumica, 2001. - Monster’s Ball), i njezine sinove blizance je njihov dom i zaštitna obiteljska povezanost. Potrebno je da ostanu povezani u svakom trenutku - čak i vezani užetom - držeći se jedan za drugog i potičući se da se nikada ne puste. Ali kada jedan od dječaka dovede u pitanje je li zlo stvarno, veze koje ih drže zajedno se prekidaju, pokrećući zastrašujuću borbu za preživljavanje.

programme.desc: Dok Zlo preuzima svijet izvan njihovog praga, jedina zaštita za majku, koju glumi dobitnica Oscara® Halle Berry (glavna glumica, 2001. - Monster’s Ball), i njezine sinove blizance je njihov dom i zaštitna obiteljska povezanost. Potrebno je da ostanu povezani u svakom trenutku - čak i vezani užetom - držeći se jedan za drugog i potičući se da se nikada ne puste. Ali kada jedan od dječaka dovede u pitanje je li zlo stvarno, veze koje ih drže zajedno se prekidaju, pokrećući zastrašujuću borbu za preživljavanje.

programme.title: Riddick, film
programme.desc: Pet godina nakon Kyrine smrti, Riddick se osjeća sve lošije u ulozi Lorda Marshalla Necromonger flote. Oduvijek neprilagođen u Necromonger carstvu, Riddick se dogovori s komandantom Vaakom (Karl Urban) da mu omogući letjelicu do planeta Furyja, dok za uzvrat Vaako može postati novi Lord Marshall. Pa tako Krone (Andreas Apergis), Riddick i grupa Necromangera stižu na pusti planet. No Riddick shvati da nisu na obećanom planetu te da su njegovi suputnici poslani s njim samo kako bi ga likvidirali. U čitavom kaosu obračuna, Krone uzrokuje odronjavanje koje zakopa Riddicka pod gomilom stijena. Izranjavan Riddick se nekako izvuče iz zamke, samo da bi ga dočekala gomila letećih predatora, zvijeri koje sliče kojotima, roj otrovnih stvorenja koji se skupljanju oko vode, tj. mulja te su nalik na ogromne škorpione. Riddick aktivira signal za pomoć, koji primaju dva broda - jedan pun plaćenika dok drugim upravlja čovjek iz Riddickove prošlosti.

programme.title: Paučina, film
programme.desc: Osmogodišnjeg Petera muči tajanstveno, stalno kucanje unutar zida njegove spavaće sobe - kuckanje za koje njegovi roditelji inzistiraju da je samo u njegovoj mašti. Kako se Peterov strah pojačava, on vjeruje da bi njegovi roditelji mogli skrivati strašnu, opasnu tajnu i dovodi u pitanje njihovo povjerenje. A za dijete, što može biti strašnije od toga?

programme.title: Dalibor Petko Show
programme.desc: Dalibor Petko Show je emisija glazbenog karaktera i uz središnjeg gosta koji svira sa svojim bendom, u studiju se izmjenjuju pjevači i grupe, promovirajući nove singlove.

programme.title: Nesavršeno ubojstvo
programme.desc: Kada je 77-godišnja udovica Louise Talley pronađena silovana i ubijena u svom domu u Nicetownu u Pennsylvaniji 1991. godine, istražitelji su se odlučili osuditi Anthonyja Wrighta za brutalni zločin.

programme.title: Lovac na ubojstva, serija
programme.desc: Pronađena su dvojica ubijenih mladića, no samo je jedan od njih dvojice žrtva. Kenda mora pomoću instinkta otkriti što se dogodilo.

programme.title: Kamera u sobi za ispitivanje
programme.desc: Osumnjičenik za pucnjavu počinje se rezati džepnim nožem nakon što ga istražitelji ostave samog u sobi za ispitivanje; žena se slomi nakon što je policiji rekla da je udavila svoju baku; čovjek priznaje ubojstvo staro 10 godina.

programme.title: Kamera u sobi za ispitivanje
programme.desc: Muškarac prestaje jecati nakon što je priznao da je izbo svoju mamu; glumica govori detektivima kako i zašto je ustrijelila svog otuđenog strica; osumnjičeni ubojica pokušava posredovati u dogovoru o imunitetu; i još mnogo toga.

programme.title: Ubojite istrage
programme.desc: Policija je pronašla naga tijela triju žena, ubijenih vatrenim oružjem i ostavljenih na zabačenim lokacijama izvan Daytona Beacha. Serijski ubojica bio je na slobodi. Slučaj je gotovo deset godina ostao neriješen, sve do otkrića četvrte ženske žrtve.

programme.title: Ubojite istrage
programme.desc: Policija je pronašla naga tijela triju žena, ubijenih vatrenim oružjem i ostavljenih na zabačenim lokacijama izvan Daytona Beacha. Serijski ubojica bio je na slobodi. Slučaj je gotovo deset godina ostao neriješen, sve do otkrića četvrte ženske žrtve.

programme.title: Spoj, vjenčanje, ubojstvo, Alisha Noel-Murray
programme.desc: Nakon što je njegov prvi brak završio razvodom, Omar Murray smatrao je da mu Alisha Noel nudi drugu šansu za ljubav. Ali ona je od života željela više nego što joj je Omar mogao pružiti. Shvatila je da joj je Omar vrjedniji mrtav nego živ.

programme.title: Prvih 48 sati, serija
programme.desc: Policija u Tulsi pronalazi ženu pretučenu na smrt tijekom provjere socijalne službe, a sin svjedoči očevu ubojstvu dok je renovirao kuću.

programme.title: Ubojstvo: Posljednji sati, Miris ubojice
programme.desc: Ključ za rješavanje najtežih ubojstava krije se u posljednja 24 sata žrtvina života. Ova dokumentarna emisija o stvarnim zločinima prati istražitelje dok pokušavaju dokučiti što se točno događalo u tim kritičnim satima.

programme.title: Ubojstvo: Posljednji sati, Neriješeni slučaj iz Anchoragea

programme.title: Upoznao sam ubojicu na internetu

There at the Berghof, the Nazi leader spent his time surrounded by his most faithful lieutenants and his mistress, Eva Braun. Though mostly destroyed, remnants of the vast building complex still exist.

programme.desc: Bienvenido a Miami! We take a look at the history behind Florida's modern metropolis. We visit the Ancient Spanish Monastery, see the opulence of the Vizcaya Museum and Gardens, and head into the swamp to learn about the Miccosukee indians.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Un-Belizable! We're off on a Central American Mayan excursion. We head up the steps of the ancient high temple at Lamanai. Then we take a city tour of the main tourist destination, Belize City. We learn about Belize's colonial roots at the Belize City History Museum and dive the amazing Blue Hole.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: How are Rainbows formed and what's their science? We look at the largest Hail ever recorded and explain why it comes in so many shapes and sizes. Global Warming is a big issue and topic, and we give a nutshell insight to its meaning and impact on many levels. Forecasting is key and crucial to living with nature and its weather, as it involves precision technologies and expertise. Typhoon Halyan is an example of one of the most devastating storms in recent history and its story illustrates the power and destruction that Typhoons can cause.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Snow is a fascinating world of crystals that animals, plants, and humans have had to adapt to, in order to benefit from its best and survive its worst attributes. Some communities live with Tornadoes by building homes with survival features and rather than get out of their paths, they rely on warning systems and classifications. And behind all great weather events is Wind, find out how and why it can change from a gentle breeze into a devastating gale force and where does it go? Nature's force can be mystical and puzzling and the Sunshower has been the subject of myths and legends and superstitions, but it does have a scientific explanation.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Chasing down Albacore Tuna 65 miles off West Coast Vancouver Island.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In Victoria just south west of Melbourne in the You Yangs National Park Ray Mears meets up with researcher Janine Duffy in a dry eucalyptus forest. They go in search of koalas and find a young male who nervously tries to establish his own territory.Ray moves down to the open grasslands and tracks a mob of Eastern Grey kangaroos. He visits the Mount Rothwell Conservation Reserve and meets an unusual marsupial _ a predator _ that is almost extinct on the mainland of Australia _ a Tiger Quoll _ smaller relative of the Tasmanian Devil. Finally Ray journeys through a Wet Eucalyptus forest to Lake Elizabeth and canoeing across the quiet waters finds himself surrounded by rare and unique duck billed platypuses

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: The Golden Temple is the centerpiece of the city of Amritsar, and probably the second most photographed building in India, but few know about the building or the people who built it. The most significant building to people of the Sikh faith, it is open to people of all faiths. We witness the celebration of the changing of the guard before heading into the mountains for a visit to the British influenced town of Shimla. Journeys then heads further north for look at the resort area of Manali.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: The people and wildlife of the western state of Gujarat have found ways to survive in an inhospitable environment. Unique big game exists side-by-side with some of the most talented and unique craftsman in the world. Bill gets the inside scoop on this strange land and is doubly surprised by his local guide.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: If there ever was a lost wildlife gem, it would be Mikumi. Here many of the Big Twelve live their lives against the backdrop of one of the most scenic parks in Africa. Bill takes a break from the wildlife safari to investigate the huge salt works at the edge of the park and how it may impact future conservation.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: South Africa has many different tribal groups and ethnic people, but none have a more fascinating story than the Zulu. These were once the most feared warriors in all of Africa and they have fiercely held onto that culture. They're also dedicated conservationists and we see first-hand the wildlife sanctuaries they've created. This is a proud people with a unique history, and we get to share that with them.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Professional skiers migrate to Valdez mountainsides to test themselves in the ultimate arena.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: A group of pro skiers travel a tough journey to South America in the hopes of experiencing the world-renown ski terrain Las Lenas, Argentina.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Of Boats And Men
programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Tentacles follows Dr. Jennifer Mather as she leads a team of renowned scientists to the beautiful Caribbean island of Bonaire. Their mission is to prove a controversial theory: reef squid speak to each other with a complex language they paint on their skin. The episode features the bizarre courtship and never-before-filmed egg-laying rituals of reef squid. Travel to the Pacific Northwest for an encounter with the world's largest Octopus. You'll also witness the fascinating hunting technique of the cuttlefish.

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: In this epic octopus adventure, Jonathan visits two aquaria to learn about the Giant Pacific octopus, and then travels to Seattle, Washington (USA) to join the Seattle Aquarium dive team on an octopus survey. He meets the Giant Pacific Octopus, the world's largest octopus, and discovers how clever this huge invertebrate really is!

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan joins shark researcher Dr. Stephen Kajiura to test how well wild sharks can detect electrical fields in their environment. Then, he heads to New Jersey (USA) to learn how to dive in the Mark V commercial diving helmet! Finally, he ends up in the Gulf of Mexico to learn how oil platforms can actually become a healthy artificial reef and attract marine life from miles around.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Dali the emperor tamarin is mysteriously going bald—on his back! Keepers suspect two mischievous monkey roommates. Meanwhile, Kristina attempts an eye ultrasound on dolphin Ulysses, needing patience and precision. And it's party time for Garoe the chimp, who celebrates his first birthday with a swinging cake surprise!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: As head of the aquarium, Ester sets a pace that's hard to keep up with _ especially on her Segway! And with a normal day including alligators, zebra sharks, jellyfish and shark pods _ you may need a Segway to keep up with this Spanish dynamo too! When Loro Parque and their volunteers conduct one of their famous beach clean ups _ you won't believe what they unearth! Even better though, a turtle rescued last year with a fishing hook in its throat is being released back to its ocean home. Now that's a good day at the beach.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Archer Fish _ A precise hunter, it shoots water jets to knock prey from above. Portia Spider _ Tiny but smart, this spider hunts others with strategy and speed. Cone Shell _ A slow-moving snail with a deadly harpoon for catching fish. Bolas Spider _ Spins sticky globules to snare prey in the dark. Slave-Making Ants _ Some ants enslave others to build their colonies. Ant Lion _ A fierce larva that traps ants in sandy pits. Pompilid Wasp _ Hunts spiders with deadly precision. Who rules the micro predator world?

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: We live in a world full of the most magnificent of animals. There are approximately eight point seven (8.7) million different species on earth. With this vast array of natural wonders how do we choose a favorite amongst all these spectacular creatures? The ethereal grace of the oceans whales, the might of the imposing hippo, the unequalled speed of the cheetah, the mesmerizing lure of the snake, the power of the elephant, the strength of the ant, the stealth of the scorpion, the extraordinary talents of the octopus, the force of the crocodile, the sheer grace of the wedge tailed eagle, or the regular commanding presence of the lion...

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: There are many fine examples of evolutionary history in the natural world. Animals evolve through small mutations to better compete for resources. Crocodiles, over 200 million years old, survived extinction due to their adaptability—slow metabolism, 4-chamber heart, and lungs that allow 2-hour dives. Sharks retained successful traits from ancient ancestors, evolving gradually. Whales transitioned from land to sea, developing echolocation, blubber, modified lungs, and enhanced hearing for survival.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Nature's battletanks—elephants, rhinos, and hippos—dominate Africa. Elephants survive on plants, yet lions and hyenas target the weak. Despite their gentle image, elephants have killed rhinos in brutal clashes. Rhinos, around for 6 million years, are tough but endangered—man is their greatest threat. Hippos are aggressive and feared, even by crocodiles. But baby hippos are vulnerable if they stray from their mothers, making them targets for predators. In the Race of Life, strength and strategy are key to survival.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Hippos are terrifying animals in their own right, but they also have enough meat on them to be tempting prey. A pride of 16 lions surround one, but its jaws can crush a skull with one bite _ who will triumph?

programme.title: Creative Killers
programme.desc: On East Africa's plains, millions of wildebeest and zebras migrate, crossing the Mara and Grumeti rivers where crocodiles lie in wait. DC, a dominant croc, faces challenges at each hunting zone—from shallow waters to rocky crossings. He battles rivals, adapts his strategy, and learns to thrive in changing conditions. As the rivers dry and herds thin, DC makes one final kill. The Mara and Grumeti demand unique skills, turning quiet waters into deadly Predator Zones.

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: Desert creatures endure searing heat and zero rainfall, but speed is their ticket to survival.A Tiger beetle runs at the human equivalent of 500 miles per hour. A caracal jumps six feet to swat a weaverbird out of midair. And the world's fastest chameleon hunts on the desert floor.Only the hardiest, fastest animals survive. Nothing else stands a chance.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Miracle Venom explores the strange, and often bizarre world of the oceans most venomous animals. Follow Dr. Glen Burns as he handles deadly Sea Snakes with only his bare hands. You'll be amazed at how a small Cone Snail hunts, paralyses and then eats it's prey alive. The waters of Papua New Guinea and Australia's Great Barrier Reef harbour an exceptional variety of venomous fish and invertebrates.The poisons of these animals are some of the most lethal known to man.They also, however, hold enormous potential in the development of therapeutic drugs.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Loro Parque, voted "World's Best Zoo" two years in a row, blends top-tier animal care with global conservation efforts. From thousands of species to multi-million-dollar research, its mission is clear: protect wildlife and inspire change. What began 45 years ago as one man's passion is now a global model of excellence in education, sustainability, and animal welfare.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: What is La Nina and how is it being monitored? Find out the effects and the reach that this system is influencing. How did Indian Summer get its name and what is the science behind the phenomenon? Winter is the season that has the biggest effect on the planet, animal behaviour and often brings out the worst that nature can bring. Nature's Halo is a magical sight with a scientific explanation. The story of and lessons from Hurricane Katrina give us a great understanding of the ferocity and speed that nature can unleash

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Weather is universal and it's also Extra Terrestrial. Learn about space weather and how it can impact us on earth. Supercells are unique storms that scientists have learnt to measure into three types. Under the earth's crust, nature is extremely energetic, and we see this through the Volcano which acts as our eye into the forces beneath our feet. Learn about the purple buzzing glow called St Elmo's Fire, how it was named and were to look for it.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Annual brood stock fishery from Percy Walkus Hatchery in Wuikinuxv, Rivers Inlet...conserving the largest Chinook on Earth!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird's eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd's Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon. Together they observe life in the canopy. Meanwhile, Ray's cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett's tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Agra is home to India's most recognizable monument—the Taj Mahal. First, we tour the Agra Fort and learn its role in the incredible history behind the Taj Mahal's construction. Bill takes us to a factory where we learn how the craft of stone inlay that adorns the Taj Mahal, is still made today. We continue on to Fatehpur Sikri, a former Mughal capital, which was created of red sandstone and displays the influence of its Hindu and Mughal roots. Finally, we meet with a man that is giving the wildlife of India a voice and sanctuary.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Two of the most sacred places in India are featured in this fascinating episode. Bill first burst the myths surrounding the legendary Khajuraho and its intricately carved temples before heading to the Holy City of Varanasi. Varanasi, the Jerusalem or Mecca for Hindus with its deep connection to the Ganges River, is explored with an insider's perspective.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: One of the Seven Natural Wonders of the World—all other great wilderness areas are compared to this vast savannah. Wildlife numbers are awesome, but nothing like the numbers of the great migration. Journeys places you in the midst of this natural phenomenon where predator and prey are on a march for survival.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Host Bill Ball begins the ascent of the highest mountain in Africa. Trouble almost immediately affects the team as the cameraman suffers from fatigue and altitude sickness. Just over halfway, the trip is in serious doubt as altitude, cold and wind force the team to evaluate their fitness to continue.

programme.title: Nomads

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: From the beginnings of our Solar System four and half billion years ago there remains tantalizing clues to its evolution; remnent debris: asteroids and comets. They vary in size from grains of dust to mountain sides, footballs to planetoids. They were the building blocks of the planets and perhaps carry the origins of life itself. Now within our grasp these rocks of ice and dust are ready to give up their secrets.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: Beyond the asteroid belt lay the ice giants, some can be seen with the naked eye, others only glimpsed once by a passing probe. We are again sending cameras to the edge of the solar system giving us new insights into the evolution of our worlds.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It's the city of love, Paris, France. The world over knows its most famous structure, the Eiffel Tower! But did you know parisians originally wanted to tear it down! We'll explain why and how it was saved! Then, you'll visit America's first pizzeria! And how the gourmet ice cream Haagen Dazs got its exotic start in Bronx New York!

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It's been sweetening America for almost 40 years! Now, find out the truth behind how Sweet N Low actually got its name! And why do we yell shotgun when getting into a car with friends? Then, is it really bad luck to open an umbrella in the house? And, learn the salty truth on how the potato chip was invented out of anger!

programme.title: Water: H2O Stories
programme.desc: Water: H2O Stories is a 3x52 series revisiting the story of water on planet Earth and its disrupted course over time which has led to the 21st century biggest challenge.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: The Past Hunters
programme.desc: The team head to Tutbury Castle in Derbyshire to investigate the paranormal reports at the location. Past Hunters appear to have caught the Tutbury Ghost on camera.

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: The R.I.P. team visits the former home of the last woman hanged for witchcraft in Virginia and encounters the spirit of the still fiercely protective foreman of her farm.

programme.title: What In the World
programme.desc: Presented by Peadar King, this series illustrates the human consequences of global economic inequalities and human rights violations, by focusing on how people encounter these issues on a daily basis.

programme.title: What In the World
programme.desc: Presented by Peadar King, this series illustrates the human consequences of global economic inequalities and human rights violations, by focusing on how people encounter these issues on a daily basis.

programme.title: Desperate Hours
programme.desc: Earthquakes have always been with us, but only in recent decades has their devastating impact been captured so vividly on film and online. In this episode, we explore scenes from some of the most destructive natural cataclysms. Of all disasters, none releases more energy than an earthquake—caused when Earth's plates grind and snap, shaking hundreds of square miles. Most occur in the Pacific "Ring of Fire." Alaska sees a 7.0 quake yearly, while California experiences about 10,000, most too small to notice.

programme.title: RV Explorers
programme.desc: RV Explorers, chasing 100 Sunsets. A TV show following a new motorhoming couple as they explore the towns and regions of NZ _ experiencing various tourist attractions, events and joining in with other motorhomers to experience their favourite activities.

programme.title: The Past Hunters
programme.desc: Ordsall Hall is over 820 years old. It has been put to many uses including a family home, working men's club and church hall. With over 15 hauntings and many sightings, Ordsall Hall will certainly keep the team busy.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In Victoria just south west of Melbourne in the You Yangs National Park Ray Mears meets up with researcher Janine Duffy in a dry eucalyptus forest. They go in search of koalas and find a young male who nervously tries to establish his own territory.Ray moves down to the open grasslands and tracks a mob of Eastern Grey kangaroos. He visits the Mount Rothwell Conservation Reserve and meets an unusual marsupial _ a predator _ that is almost extinct on the mainland of Australia _ a Tiger Quoll _ smaller relative of the Tasmanian Devil. Finally Ray journeys through a Wet Eucalyptus forest to Lake Elizabeth and canoeing across the quiet waters finds himself surrounded by rare and unique duck billed platypuses

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird's eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd's Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon. Together they observe life in the canopy. Meanwhile, Ray's cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett's tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Posse the red panda and Santiago the saki have been having issues with their teeth. The dentist has arrived but he's got some good news and bad news. The good news is neither of them have to foot the bill. The bad news is, he's brought his big pliers! Ever heard the tale of how the blue throated macaw parrot was saved from extinction and started a new fashion trend in the process? Loro Parque reports from the Bolivian front line and the front row of the local fashion parade!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: For over a year, the staff at Loro Parque have been patiently waiting for a huge event to take place. Morgan, the deaf orca is about to give birth to her very first calf. The stakes are high, and the staff are holding their collective breath as the scene is set for the greatest natural phenomenon in the zoo's history.

programme.title: Meet My Wild Friend
programme.desc: Gasp at animal power, gawp at childhood innocence, this is the true story of children who live as friends with wild animals.

programme.title: European Islands
programme.desc: The European islands are renowned primarily for their hotel resorts. However, we will show you a completely different face of theirs: forests, beaches, coves, mountains, valleys and rivers. Perhaps you will find places that will take your breath away. Why just lie on the beach when there is so much to see? Put on some good hiking shoes, pull your shoelaces tight, and get to know the entire island like the back of your hand.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The most venomous snake on land. The deserted heart of the Australian outback, where people seldom venture, is the hot, baked home of the most venomous land snake in the world _ the inland taipan, a two meter long snake with enough venom in one bite to kill a quarter of a million mice. Gila Monster _ North America's largest land lizard, venomous and striking, lives in desert regions. Blue-Ringed Octopus _ Tiny but deadly, it carries two venoms—one lethal to humans. Red-Back Spider _ Hidden in messy webs, the female's scarlet stripe warns of her deadly bite. Sydney Funnel-Web _ Aggressive and armed with toxic venom, the male is especially dangerous. Which venomous creature is the deadliest?

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Wildebeest & Zebra _ Africa's iconic drifters. No two zebra have the same stripes, even in vast herds. Olive Ridley Turtles _ The world's most abundant sea turtle, migrating vast distances to nest. Sooty Tern _ These seabirds may stay airborne for years before returning to land to breed. Australian Pelicans _ Big-billed birds that follow inland waterways in search of fish. Whales & Whale Sharks _ Ocean giants that roam the seas, some on epic migrations we barely understand. Some of the greatest migratory animals on earth are those that live in its waters and traverse its great oceans. From baleen whales that travel from the nutrient rich polar waters and the whale sharks whose migrations we barely understand.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Tentacles follows Dr. Jennifer Mather as she leads a team of renowned scientists to the beautiful Caribbean island of Bonaire. Their mission is to prove a controversial theory: reef squid speak to each other with a complex language they paint on their skin. The episode features the bizarre courtship and never-before-filmed egg-laying rituals of reef squid. Travel to the Pacific Northwest for an encounter with the world's largest Octopus. You'll also witness the fascinating hunting technique of the cuttlefish.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Deserts are dry, extreme places with little rain and few plants. Semi-deserts support more life, but survival is still tough. Animals adapt to heat and water scarcity—some drink rarely, get moisture from food, or travel far for water. Many seek shade, burrow, or are nocturnal. Scorpions, ancient and armored, use pincers and venom to survive. Rattlesnakes, fast and deadly, are feared—except by roadrunners, who hunt them. Desert life demands resilience, cleverness, and unique adaptations

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Nature's battletanks—elephants, rhinos, and hippos—dominate Africa. Elephants survive on plants, yet lions and hyenas target the weak. Despite their gentle image, elephants have killed rhinos in brutal clashes. Rhinos, around for 6 million years, are tough but endangered—man is their greatest threat. Hippos are aggressive and feared, even by crocodiles. But baby hippos are vulnerable if they stray from their mothers, making them targets for predators. In the Race of Life, strength and strategy are key to survival.

programme.title: On the Cities' Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan heads down to the shipwrecks of North Carolina (USA) to observe how these wrecks have become home to thousands of animals, including Sand Tiger sharks. But instead of chasing all the fish, the sharks are protecting many of them! Then, Jonathan visits the School for Field Studies in the Turks & Caicos Islands to learn how college students conduct fieldwork in their pursuit of degrees in Marine Studies. He helps tag sharks, study conch and investigate marine protected areas!

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: In a shark-filled adventure, Jonathan travels to the Bahamas to meet Neal Harvey, a world-renown shark handler who will attempt to teach Jonathan how to put Caribbean Reef sharks into a relaxed state known as tonic immobility! Then, Jonathan heads to NASA's Neutral Buoyancy Lab in Houston, Texas (USA), where astronauts train for space walking underwater, in a giant pool about half the size of a soccer field. Jonathan gets a rare and fascinating look into this high-tech diving as he ventures underwater with the astronauts.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Humans have long dreamed of flight—from da Vinci's flapping-wing designs to massive cow-gut-filled airships. The Wright brothers, inspired by bicycles, built strong, controllable kites that led to early planes. Modern jets fly faster thanks to high-altitude, low-resistance flight, an idea sparked by Frank Whittle's Aeolipile experiments. From the Airbus A380 to NASA's scramjet, aviation keeps evolving—what's next in flight innovation?

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Cooling is essential today, but it began with icehouses and lake-cut ice. The "ice industry" faded due to pollution. Air-conditioning was invented to control humidity, not temperature. Cold isn't created—it's moved. The first fridge was built to fight malaria, but early models leaked toxic gases. Even Einstein designed a safer version. Later, refrigerants harmed the environment. Now, scientists explore sound vibrations as a cleaner cooling method.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: On a hot summer's day, nothing cools you down like a frozen fruity popsicle! You'll learn how an 11-year old boy created this sweet icy treat! And, have you ever noticed those colored spinning poles outside the barbershop? You'll be in stitches when you learn how they got their start! Plus, find out how a melting chocolate bar gave way to the invention of the microwave!

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It was the purrrfect idea for making our furry friends more pleasant around the house! You'll learn how litty litter clawed its way into our homes. And you'll learn how a garment made out of special woven fibers can stop a bullet, plus, why is walking under a ladder bad luck? And finally, we'll "cut to the chase" and explain the history behind this common phrase!

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: New satellites are being launched to continue detailed observations of Earth and its oceans an ice caps, They are finding that climate change is accelerating and they have the data to prove it.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: NASA'S Parker Solar Probe Mission is on its way and will be shortly followed by Europe's Solar probe Mission. No spacecraft have traveled so fast or so close to a star before. It is hoped to reveal the source of the solar winds that effect us here on Earth.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: The Body Transfer Illusion tricks the brain into feeling ownership of a fake body part, like in the rubber hand experiment. The Autokinetic Effect makes stationary lights seem to move in darkness. The Moon Illusion causes the moon to appear larger near the horizon due to visual references. Geometric illusions distort shapes and lines through clever design. Stereoscopy lets us perceive depth by merging two flat images into one 3D view.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Animation creates motion from still images shown in rapid sequence. Aviation illusions affect pilots' balance due to conflicting sensory input. The spinning dancer illusion shows bistable perception—viewers may see it spin in either direction. Mirages occur when light bends through layers of air at different temperatures. Rainbows form when sunlight refracts and reflects through water droplets, splitting light into visible colors.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Bijeg na selo
programme.desc: Bijeg u unutrašnjost vraća se s novom serijom potraga za savršenim domom obitelji koje žele pobjeći od života u gradu. Svaka epizoda prikazuje par ili obitelj koja razmišlja o bijegu i selidbi u ruralnu Englesku.

programme.title: Ja sam Luke Perry
programme.desc: Dugometražni dokumentarac slavi život Lukea Perryja, velikog talenta cijele jedne generacije koji je potekao iz skromne obitelji, izronio iz anonimnosti maloga grada te postao holivudski ljepotan i legenda popularne culture. Producent filma je Lukeov prijatelj i kolega iz serije Beverly Hills Jason Priestley. Od uloge Dylana McKaya u Beverly Hillsu, koja ga je proslavila, do najizazovnijih filmskih uloga u Normalnom životu i filmu 8 Seconds, Luke je nastavio donositi popularne izvedbe u seriji Riverdale i filmu Quentina Tarantina Bilo jednom... u Hollywoodu. Film predstavlja talente nepokolebljivo skromnog i vrijednog umjetnika koji je nadišao svoje početke tinejdžerskog ljepotana i postao ozbiljan i široko priznat glumac na filmu i televiziji, čiji je opus dirnuo milijune gledatelja. Uz odabran izbor rijetkih i poznatih fotografija, snimki i memorabilija iz privatnih zbirki i svjetski poznatih arhiva te nove intervjue s onima koji su Lukeovu talentu svjedočili izravnije od ikoga - filmašima, glumcima i uspješnim kolegama iz njegove tri desetljeća duge karijere - film prati izvanredan život i karijeru jednog od najomiljenijih filmskih idola suvremenog Hollywooda.

programme.title: Steve Backshall i kitovi
programme.desc: „Steve Backshall i kitovi daje zadivljujući i sveobuhvatan pregled svijeta kitova, dupina i pliskavica. Avanturist i voditelj Steve Backshall putuje od Azora do Arktika snimajući podvodne snimke koje oduzimaju dah u svakom jedinstvenom staništu. Koristeći najnoviju tehnologiju, uključujući sićušne dronove i split-rig kamere, te najnovija znanstvena istraživanja, serija promatra dosad neviđena ponašanja i dovodi nas u podvodna kraljevstva moćnih kitova. Kroz četiri epizode, Steve Backshall ulazi u svijet kitova - od Južnog Pacifika do Kariba - susrećući se s njima pod njihovim uvjetima kako bi otkrio kako te životinje koriste svoju inteligenciju za lov, komunikaciju i čak podučavanje svojih mladih. Roni s tim životinjama kako bi ih snimao izbliza bez da ih uznemirava, također uči o izazovima s kojima se kitovi i dupini suočavaju u divljini, upoznajući ljude koji rade na njihovoj zaštiti od klimatskih promjena i onečišćenja zajedno sa znanstvenicima koji koriste sonarnu tehnologiju za praćenje ovih životinja. Informativan, privlačan i vitalan za naše razumijevanje „Steve Backshall i kitovi prirodoslovna je serija koja nam daje bolji uvid u ta veličanstvena stvorenja nego ikad prije.

programme.title: Osamdesete
programme.desc: Dio izvanredne dokumentarne serije „Desetljeća, koju su producirali Tom Hanks, Gary Goetzman i Mark Herzog, „Osamdesete su fascinantan, uzbudljiv skup filmova koji prikazuju desetljeće koje je promijenilo Ameriku - i svijet. Kako desetljeća prolaze, osamdesete su bile velike. Svijetu je zastao dah kad je Hladni rat došao do vrhunca i konačno do kraja. Proživjeli smo krizu AIDS-a i vidjeli kako brokeri s Wall Streeta postaju nove rock zvijezde. Disco 70-e su završile, a glazba, film i društvene promjene najavile su pomak koji i danas odjekuje. Ova fascinantna dokumentarna mini-serija briljantno koristi arhivske snimke i intervjue kako bi istaknula ključne trenutake desetljeća, čineći gledanje uvjerljivim i zabavnim, bilo da se nostalgično vraćate u posjet ili otkrivate povijest.

programme.title: Velika putovanja željeznicom kroz Veliku Britaniju
programme.desc: Sezonu po sezonu, pridružujemo se Michaelu Portillu dok putuje željeznicom uzduž i poprijeko Velike Britanije, istražujući povijest nacije i prateći ogromne društvene, političke i kulturne promjene koje su tijekom godina željeznice donijele sa sobom. Otkrivamo kako je Britanija oblikovana rastućom mrežom povijesnih željeznica, s fascinantnim uvidima i likovima na svakoj stanici na putu. Uvijek informativan i često dirljiv, serijal Željeznička putovanja nastavlja oduševljavati i zabavljati publiku diljem svijeta.

programme.title: Vrhunski dizajn u Velikoj Britaniji
programme.desc: Serija donosi pogled na neobične domove te istražuje kuće koje se grade na različitim lokacijama u Velikoj Britaniji, a svaka epizoda pokazat će koja dizajnerska rješenja najbolje funkcioniraju i zašto. Na početku epizode voditelj Kevin McCloud upoznaje klijente koji se upuštaju u projekt; s njima obilazi nekretninu i razgovara o planovima za gradnju da bismo potom vidjeli i kompjutersku vizualizaciju cijelog projekta. Nakon toga prati napredak, pregledava materijale i vodi brigu o tome hoće li sve biti završeno na vrijeme, a kad se usele stanari, McCloud opisuje cijeli proces gradnje.

programme.title: Biserno dugme, film
programme.desc: Kadrovi površine oceana, naracija iz koje doznajemo da ispod plavog pokrova leže tisuće žrtava generala Pinocheta koji je 1973. u Čileu vojnim pučem svrgnuo socijalističku vladu Salvadora Allendea i dozivaju žive. Ali ocean nije samo njihov grob. U drugom dijelu diptiha o smrti i životu koji nastoji opstati stiješnjen između dviju grobnica - oceana i pustinje - Guzmán pripovijeda o stradanjima naroda Yagan pri susretu s europskim kolonizatorima u Ognjenoj zemlji stoljećima prije. Novo remek-djelo čileanskog majstora pokušaj je da se pažljivim uvezivanjem forenzike, povijesti i kozmologije u filmsku priču istodobno istkaju nove veze između živih i mrtvih koji vrište iz svojih grobova s onu stranu bilo kakve osvete.

programme.title: Portugal s Michaelom Portillom
programme.desc: Michael Portillo nastavlja svoje putovanje otkrivanja Portugala u još jednoj regiji koju Britanci posebno vole, na čudesnom otočju izvan portugalskog kopna. Više od 800 km od obale Algarvea i oko 500 km zapadno od afričke obale Michael ponovno otkriva portugalski teritorij, suptropski otok Madeiru koji je posljednji put posjetio prije više od 30 godina. Madeira se redovito proglašava jednim od najboljih svjetskih otočnih odredišta, a svake godine privuče do dva milijuna posjetitelja, od kojih mnogi slijeću na dojmljivo projektiranu zračnu luku koja doslovno lebdi iznad oceana, poduprta stupovima. Madeira je mala, ali bogata krajnostima i bujnim raslinjem. Upola manji od Londona s okolicom, ovaj vulkanski otok uzdiže se okomito iz Atlantika do visine iznad 1800 m. Većina posjetitelja putovanje počinje u glavnom gradu Funchalu, na jugoistočnoj strani otoka, kamo Michael dolazi u jedinstvenim saonicama od pletera, carros de cesto, koje se spuštaju niza strme gradske ulice na drvenim klizačima, a voze ih carreiros. Ove toboganske saonice potječu iz 19. stoljeća kad su imućni stanovnici povijesne četvrti Monte tražili brz način za silazak u grad. Danas su jedna od najpopularnijih otočnih atrakcija. Nakon istraživanja povijesne obale Funchala Michael kreće prema unutrašnjosti otoka, poznatoj po veličanstvenim krajolicima i prirodnim ljepotama. Ovdje traga za povijesnom mrežom kanala za navodnjavanje, levadas, koje su prvi portugalski doseljenici izgradili kako bi vodu s vlažnijeg sjevera preusmjerili prema sušnijem jugu, za potrebe plantaža šećerne trske i poljodjelstva...

programme.title: Sestrinstvo zadimljene saune
programme.desc: „Sestrinstvo zadimljene saune intiman je portret sestrinstva stvorenog u sigurnom prostoru, izoliranom od ostatka svijeta, u kojem međusobna iskrenost, povjerenje, strpljenje i potpora otvaraju mogućnost liječenja duše, a ne samo tijela. U tami zadimljene saune, žene dijele svoje najdublje tajne i intimna iskustva, ispirajući sramotu zarobljenu u njihovim tijelima i vraćajući snagu kroz osjećaj zajedništva.

programme.desc: „Sestrinstvo zadimljene saune intiman je portret sestrinstva stvorenog u sigurnom prostoru, izoliranom od ostatka svijeta, u kojem međusobna iskrenost, povjerenje, strpljenje i potpora otvaraju mogućnost liječenja duše, a ne samo tijela. U tami zadimljene saune, žene dijele svoje najdublje tajne i intimna iskustva, ispirajući sramotu zarobljenu u njihovim tijelima i vraćajući snagu kroz osjećaj zajedništva.

programme.title: Neka bude zakon
programme.desc: U Argentini tjedno umire jedna žena uslijed ilegalnog abortusa. Godine 2018. po sedmi je puta argentinskom kongresu podnesen zahtjev za legalizacijom abortusa. Taj je zahtjev izazvao vatrenu raspravu i razotkrio veliku podjelu između pro-life ljudi i onih koji se zalažu za slobodu prilikom odlučivanja. Kroz brojne strastvene ispovjedi, film „Neka bude zakon dokumentira borbu žena za tjelesnim samoodređenjem i svjedoči masovnim mobilizacijama na ulicama Buenos Airesa.

programme.title: V-11: Najveći skandal Premier lige
programme.desc: Dijelom istraživački triler, a dijelom kolekciija osobnih svjedočanstava, V-11 je šokantno razotkrivanje najvećeg skandala u povijesti engleske Premier lige, otkrivajući mračnu stranu igre koju su mnogi željeli zadržati u tajnosti. Sniman i produciran tijekom dvije godine, V-11 je skupina od 11 bivših nogometaša Premier lige koje iskorištavaju podmukli prevaranti koji djeluju u srcu elitnog profesionalnog nogometa. Ovo je priča o potrazi za pravdom koju su igrači otkrili krooz vlastite ispovjesti. Dvodjelni dokumentarac prati njih i njihove pravne timove u mukotrpnoj i dramatičnoj potrazi za istinom. Kroz svjedočanstva zviždača i nevjerojatne detaljne dokaze, ova zadivljujuća serija razotkriva sustavnu kulturu financijskog iskorištavanja i zlostavljanje industrijskih razmjera koje su pretrpjeli poznata imena koja su igrala u nekim od najpoznatijih klubova na svijetu.

programme.title: Osamdesete
programme.desc: Dio izvanredne dokumentarne serije „Desetljeća, koju su producirali Tom Hanks, Gary Goetzman i Mark Herzog, „Osamdesete su fascinantan, uzbudljiv skup filmova koji prikazuju desetljeće koje je promijenilo Ameriku - i svijet. Kako desetljeća prolaze, osamdesete su bile velike. Svijetu je zastao dah kad je Hladni rat došao do vrhunca i konačno do kraja. Proživjeli smo krizu AIDS-a i vidjeli kako brokeri s Wall Streeta postaju nove rock zvijezde. Disco 70-e su završile, a glazba, film i društvene promjene najavile su pomak koji i danas odjekuje. Ova fascinantna dokumentarna mini-serija briljantno koristi arhivske snimke i intervjue kako bi istaknula ključne trenutake desetljeća, čineći gledanje uvjerljivim i zabavnim, bilo da se nostalgično vraćate u posjet ili otkrivate povijest.

programme.title: Velika putovanja željeznicom kroz Veliku Britaniju
programme.desc: Sezonu po sezonu, pridružujemo se Michaelu Portillu dok putuje željeznicom uzduž i poprijeko Velike Britanije, istražujući povijest nacije i prateći ogromne društvene, političke i kulturne promjene koje su tijekom godina željeznice donijele sa sobom. Otkrivamo kako je Britanija oblikovana rastućom mrežom povijesnih željeznica, s fascinantnim uvidima i likovima na svakoj stanici na putu. Uvijek informativan i često dirljiv, serijal Željeznička putovanja nastavlja oduševljavati i zabavljati publiku diljem svijeta.

programme.title: Vrhunski dizajn u Velikoj Britaniji
programme.desc: Serija donosi pogled na neobične domove te istražuje kuće koje se grade na različitim lokacijama u Velikoj Britaniji, a svaka epizoda pokazat će koja dizajnerska rješenja najbolje funkcioniraju i zašto. Na početku epizode voditelj Kevin McCloud upoznaje klijente koji se upuštaju u projekt; s njima obilazi nekretninu i razgovara o planovima za gradnju da bismo potom vidjeli i kompjutersku vizualizaciju cijelog projekta. Nakon toga prati napredak, pregledava materijale i vodi brigu o tome hoće li sve biti završeno na vrijeme, a kad se usele stanari, McCloud opisuje cijeli proces gradnje.

programme.title: Pogled u vječnost
programme.desc: Postojeća nadzemna skladišta otpada, podložna prirodnim katastrofama i ljudskom faktoru, samo su privremeno rješenje za taj potpuno novi problem. Pet kilometara ispod zemlje Finci grade golemu grobnicu, posljednje počivalište njihova udjela u otpadu. Nazvan ‘Onkalo’ (finska riječ za skrovište), taj tunel dug pet kilometara bit će zapečaćen do 2100. godine, nakon čega ga se ne bi smjelo dirati barem idućih 100 tisuća godina. Stotinu tisuća godina. U ovom poetskom, nezaboravno lijepom dokumentarcu, danski redatelj Michael Madsen razgovara s vrhunskim skandinavskim stručnjacima za atomsku energiju i silazi u mračan tunel s radnicima koji eksplozivom razbijaju stijene, no njegov pristup tom zastrašujućem i intenzivnom pitanju više je filozofski nego akademski: koliko su dalekosežne posljedice našeg načina života?

programme.title: Sestrinstvo zadimljene saune
programme.desc: „Sestrinstvo zadimljene saune intiman je portret sestrinstva stvorenog u sigurnom prostoru, izoliranom od ostatka svijeta, u kojem međusobna iskrenost, povjerenje, strpljenje i potpora otvaraju mogućnost liječenja duše, a ne samo tijela. U tami zadimljene saune, žene dijele svoje najdublje tajne i intimna iskustva, ispirajući sramotu zarobljenu u njihovim tijelima i vraćajući snagu kroz osjećaj zajedništva.

programme.title: Portugal s Michaelom Portillom
programme.desc: Michael Portillo nastavlja svoje putovanje otkrivanja Portugala u još jednoj regiji koju Britanci posebno vole, na čudesnom otočju izvan portugalskog kopna. Više od 800 km od obale Algarvea i oko 500 km zapadno od afričke obale Michael ponovno otkriva portugalski teritorij, suptropski otok Madeiru koji je posljednji put posjetio prije više od 30 godina. Madeira se redovito proglašava jednim od najboljih svjetskih otočnih odredišta, a svake godine privuče do dva milijuna posjetitelja, od kojih mnogi slijeću na dojmljivo projektiranu zračnu luku koja doslovno lebdi iznad oceana, poduprta stupovima. Madeira je mala, ali bogata krajnostima i bujnim raslinjem. Upola manji od Londona s okolicom, ovaj vulkanski otok uzdiže se okomito iz Atlantika do visine iznad 1800 m. Većina posjetitelja putovanje počinje u glavnom gradu Funchalu, na jugoistočnoj strani otoka, kamo Michael dolazi u jedinstvenim saonicama od pletera, carros de cesto, koje se spuštaju niza strme gradske ulice na drvenim klizačima, a voze ih carreiros. Ove toboganske saonice potječu iz 19. stoljeća kad su imućni stanovnici povijesne četvrti Monte tražili brz način za silazak u grad. Danas su jedna od najpopularnijih otočnih atrakcija. Nakon istraživanja povijesne obale Funchala Michael kreće prema unutrašnjosti otoka, poznatoj po veličanstvenim krajolicima i prirodnim ljepotama. Ovdje traga za povijesnom mrežom kanala za navodnjavanje, levadas, koje su prvi portugalski doseljenici izgradili kako bi vodu s vlažnijeg sjevera preusmjerili prema sušnijem jugu, za potrebe plantaža šećerne trske i poljodjelstva...

programme.title: Bijeg na selo
programme.desc: Bijeg u unutrašnjost vraća se s novom serijom potraga za savršenim domom obitelji koje žele pobjeći od života u gradu. Svaka epizoda prikazuje par ili obitelj koja razmišlja o bijegu i selidbi u ruralnu Englesku.

programme.title: Portugal s Michaelom Portillom
programme.desc: Michael Portillo nastavlja svoje putovanje otkrivanja pravog Portugala u dvama iznimno zanimljivim gradovima, Coimbri i Aveiru, koji su nekoć bili dio moćne rimske provincije. Putovanje počinje u Aveiru, šarmantnom gradiću poznatom po kanalima i šareno ukrašenim čamcima, smještenom samo sat vožnje južno od Porta. Zbog toga ga često nazivaju portugalskom Venecijom. Michael počinje dan radnim ručkom u lokalnom restoranu gdje pomaže u pripremi regionalnog specijaliteta, pirjanih jegulja. Nakon toga otkriva omiljenu portugalsku slasticu ovos moles koja se izrađuje od žumanjaka i šećera te umata u tanku hostiju. Zatim doznaje i o zanimljivoj povijesnoj poveznici između svetice zaštitnice Aveira, princeze Joane, i engleskoga kralja Richarda III. Michael otkriva i povijest glasovitih čamaca moliceiro. Iako sliče gondolama, izvorno su služili za vađenje morske trave iz obližnje lagun. Iz Aveira Michael se vozi oko 60 km jugoistočno, u jedan od najvažnijih portugalskih gradova, Coimbru. Ovaj grad bio je središte velike rimske provincije koja je vladala današnjim teritorijem Portugala gotovo 700 godina. Ondje otkriva ostatke rimskoga grada Aeminiuma, duboko ispod zemlje. Arheolozi su ispod današnjih zgrada pronašli dvokatnu građevinu koja je služila kao skladište i prostor za tajne aktivnosti, a u kojoj su pronađeni brojni iznimni rimski artefakti. Od 1139. Coimbra je bila i prva prijestolnica Portugala, u razdoblju od više od stotinu godina, a danas je u njoj najstarije portugalsko sveučilište. Kao studentski grad, Coimbra nudi sadržaje za sve naraštaje. Michael istražuje strme, popločane ulice, a najbolji način da se doživi Coimbra je pješice...

programme.title: Putovanje jednog soba, film
programme.desc: Upoznajte Ailoa, novorođenog soba koji se upušta na nevjerojatno odiseju uz pomoć svoje majke. U naraciji velikog holivudskog glumca Donalda Sutherlanda te postavljen u pozadinu smrznutog kraljevstva sjeverne Finske, njihovo putovanje nevjerojatna je priča u kojoj će uživati cijela obitelj.

programme.title: Ja i Bowie: Priča o Micku Ronsonu
programme.desc: „Ja i Bowie: Priča o Micku Ronsonu dokumentarac je o životu i radu Michaela Micka Ronsona, gitaristi, glazbenom autoru, producentu i aranžeru koji je u ranoj fazi svoje karijere nastupao s Davidom Bowieom kao jedan od ‘Spiders from Mars’.

programme.title: Stvaranje zvučnih valova
programme.desc: „Stvaranje zvučnih valova otkriva skrivenu snagu zvuka u kinu. Kroz filmske isječke, intervjue i stare snimke, film prikazuje povijest, utjecaj i stvaralački proces ove zanemarene umjetničke forme kroz uvide i priče legendarnih redatelja kao što su George Lucas, Steven Spielberg, David Lynch, Barbra Streisand, Ang Lee, Christopher Nolan, Sofia Coppola i Ryan Coogler, kao i muškaraca i žena s kojima surađuju. Malo je onih koji imaju "uši za slušanje" ili shvaćaju emocionalni utjecaj zvuka na pripovijedanja u takozvanim vizualnim medijima. Francis Ford Coppola i George Lucas izjavili su da je "zvuk 50% filma", a Spielberg je rekao "da naše uši vode naše oči tamo gdje priča živi".
